ai_overview.visible_text:
Experiment Beauty's Super Saturated serum and Molecular Mesh moisturizer are hyped as holy grail hydration products, but they can sometimes leave very dry skin feeling dry if used incorrectly or if they lack enough heavy occlusives.
Why They Might Feel Drying
Humectant Focus: Super Saturated relies on 30% glycerin and polyglutamic acid. These are humectants that pull water into the skin. If you live in a dry climate or do not seal them in with a heavy cream, they can pull moisture out of your skin instead.
Instagram
+2
Lighter Texture: Molecular Mesh is a barrier-strengthening moisturizer, but some users find it lighter than expected. It acts like a water cream or a light occlusive web, which may not be enough for chronically dry or severely damaged skin barriers on its own.
Reddit
·r/30PlusSkinCare
+3
Mixed Results: On Reddit, opinions are mixed; while many praise the hydration, others with intense dryness feel like the products "did nothing" or evaporated without providing lasting comfort.

How to Fix It
Apply on Damp Skin: Always put Super Saturated onto wet or damp skin so the glycerin has actual water to bind to.
Layer a Heavier Cream: If Molecular Mesh feels like it dries down too fast, follow it with a thicker occlusive cream or facial oil to lock the hydration in place.
